title: URL Shortener — Problem Definition
subtitle: Scope and core requirements for a global URL shortening service

panels.title: Functional Requirements
panels.body:
- Shorten long URLs to 7-char codes
- Redirect short URLs to original (301/302)
- Support custom aliases (vanity URLs)
- Link analytics (click counts, referer)
- URL expiration (cleanup background job)

panels.title: Out-of-Scope
panels.body:
- User authentication/accounts
- QR code generation
- Link-in-bio page builders
- Advanced API rate limiting details
